verdict.rationale: Dynadot advertises a free custom email service on your domain (dynadot-docs-16), which could cover forwarding, but there is no evidence that SSL certificates are free — the SSL page (dynadot-docs-15, dynadot-docs-31) describes DV certificates without stating a price or 'free' tier, and Dynadot SSL is typically a paid add-on for registrars. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation of free SSL certificates, and clarity that the email offering is specifically forwarding (not just a paid mailbox product).
